Westside Wednesday Ride

Detroit, MI · Social

Westside Wednesday Ride is a social group ride in Detroit, MI. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:00 pm from Gordon Park.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 7:00 PM EDT

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

The Detroit Greenways Coalition's community calendar, edited in July 2026, lists the Westside Wednesday Ride (Detroit Lane Bangerz) from Gordon Park, meet 6 PM, roll out 7 PM, through Oct 28, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026).

When
Every Wednesday, 7:00 pmWednesdays, meet 6:00 pm, roll out 7:00 pm, from Gordon Park. The calendar runs it through Oct 28, 2026.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Westside Wednesday Ride group ride
